definitions.name: F1D.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: index of the largest number in a Vector; the first of them when several tie

definitions.name: F1D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TKR' BIND TKR KEYS TKR VALUES F1D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest; the earliest key when several tie

definitions.name: F1D.WHERE
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: values mask -> the elements of values whose aligned mask lane is TRUE, in order

definitions.name: F1D.COUNT-TRUE
definitions.body: 'CTV' BIND 1 0 CTV SELECT G0A.SUM
definitions.note: how many lanes of a Vector of truths are TRUE

definitions.name: F1D.SPACED
definitions.body: '' [ 'SPW' BIND ' ' SPW 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of words (no whitespace inside) with single spaces

definitions.name: F1D.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CPC' BIND CPC 0 GET UPPER CPC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: a non-empty word with its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased

definitions.name: F1D.VMAX
definitions.body: 'VXV' BIND VXV VXV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F1D.VMIN
definitions.body: 'VMV' BIND VMV VMV 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F1D.SPREAD
definitions.body: 'SPV' BIND SPV F1D.VMAX SPV F1D.VMIN SUB
definitions.note: largest minus smallest of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F1D.ABS
definitions.body: 'ABV' BIND ABV ABV -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value; lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: F1D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MSV' BIND MSV LENGTH 'MLN' BIND MSV MLN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MSV MLN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middles when even)

definitions.name: F1D.MAD
definitions.body: 'MDV' BIND MDV MDV F1D.MEDIAN SUB F1D.ABS F1D.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: F1D.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'M3V' BIND M3V -2 DROP M3V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD M3V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers (input of at least three)

definitions.name: F1D.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'RMV' BIND RMV RMV 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty Vector, same length as the input

definitions.name: F1D.MODE
definitions.body: SORT TALLY F1D.TOPKEY
definitions.note: most frequent number of a Vector; the smallest when several tie

definitions.name: F1D.LEDGER-SUMS
definitions.body: ZIP [ 'LGN' 'LGA' ] BIND LGN LGA G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name to sum of its amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: F1D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DVN' BIND 1 DVN RANGE 'DVS' BIND DVS DVN DVS G0A.MOD 1 LT F1D.WHERE
definitions.note: ascending positive divisors of a positive integer

definitions.name: F1D.IS-PRIME
definitions.body: 'PRK' BIND PRK 1 PRK RANGE G0A.MOD 1 LT F1D.COUNT-TRUE 2 EQ
definitions.note: whether a positive integer is prime (exactly two divisors)

definitions.name: F1D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BNN' BIND BNN 2 5 0 RANGE POW DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD STR JOIN 'BNS' BIND BNS CHARS BNS '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 written in base 2 as a String without leading zeros

definitions.name: F1D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CZN' BIND 1 150 RANGE CZN 0 2 COLLECT [ 'CZI' BIND [ 'CZC' 'CZS' ] BIND CZC CZC 2 DIV CZC 3 MUL 1 ADD CZC 2 G0A.MOD 1 LT SELECT CZC 1 EQ SELECT CZS CZS 1 ADD CZC 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: Collatz steps from a positive integer down to 1 (up to 150 steps)

definitions.name: F1D.FIBS
definitions.body: 'FBN' BIND 1 FBN RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'FBI' BIND [ 'FBA' 'FBB' ] BIND FBB FBA FBB ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: n -> the first n Fibonacci numbers F(1)=1, F(2)=1, ...

definitions.name: F1D.DIGITAL-ROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 9 G0A.MOD 1 ADD
definitions.note: digital root of a positive integer

definitions.name: F1D.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'RVO' BIND RVO 'qty' GET RVO 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> total of qty times price over the priced orders

definitions.name: F1D.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'QBO' BIND QBO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP QBO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> Record sku to sum of qty, first-appearance order

solutions.ledger.debtors: F1D.LEDGER-SUMS 'LDR' BIND LDR KEYS LDR VALUES 0 LT F1D.WHERE
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LEV' BIND LEV LEV ZIP 1 GET F1D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ F1D.CAP ] MAP F1D.SPACED
solutions.number.fib_index: 'FXN' BIND 20 F1D.FIBS FXN LT F1D.COUNT-TRUE 1 ADD
solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.stats.normalize: 'NZV' BIND NZV NZV F1D.VMIN SUB NZV F1D.SPREAD DIV
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
